name: three
description: Node module-resolution shim ONLY, for running web/js/*.js under `node` in tests (tests/test_viewer_jitter.py). Not a second copy of Three.js: 'three.module.js' and 'addons/' in this directory are symlinks back to the already-vendored web/vendor/three/, the same files the browser's importmap in web/index.html resolves 'three' and 'three/addons/' to. No file content is duplicated and nothing here ships to the browser.
